quarterly_data.quarter: AT&S press release: AT&S delivers a strong first quarter and reaffirms (08-04-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Q1 2026/27: consolidated revenue EUR 549 million (PY: EUR 399 million), up 40% adjusted for currency, driven in particular by positive volume and pricing effects. EBITDA up roughly 134% to EUR 165 million at a 30.1% margin; EBIT EUR 73 million, above the EUR 66 million of the entire financial year 2025/26; EPS EUR 0.93 (PY: EUR -1.55). Net CAPEX EUR 35 million, mostly for the new Kulim plant. CEO Michael Mertin: 'We are benefiting from continued strong demand in our core markets.'
quarterly_data.figure: Q1 revenue EUR 549 million (+40% currency-adjusted); EBITDA EUR 165 million (30.1% margin); EBIT EUR 73 million; EPS EUR 0.93

quarterly_data.quarter: AT&S press release: AT&S delivers a strong first quarter and reaffirms (08-04-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Increased outlook for financial year 2026/27 confirmed: constant-currency revenue growth of 45 to 55% and an EBITDA margin of 32 to 37%; management plans CAPEX of roughly EUR 1.0 to 1.2 billion for 2026/27 and positive operating free cash flow supported by the operating business and expected customer payments. The forecast excludes a significant deterioration of the geopolitical situation and of the currently tight supply situation for certain materials.
quarterly_data.figure: FY2026/27 revenue growth 45-55% constant currency; EBITDA margin 32-37%; CAPEX roughly EUR 1.0-1.2 billion

quarterly_data.quarter: AT&S press release: AT&S delivers a strong first quarter and reaffirms (08-04-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Kulim (Malaysia) expansion, announced mid-June based on agreements with customer AMD and another leading technology company: fit-out of the existing plant 2 structure and construction of a new manufacturing site for IC substrate cores and advanced PCBs. Planned investments of EUR 1.5 to 2.0 billion are fully supported by long-term customer commitments; the agreements are subject to final negotiation and conclusion. The Chongqing (China) expansion decided in May requires CAPEX in the double-digit million euro range, also fully supported by long-term customer agreements. Capacity expansions are described as fully on schedule.
quarterly_data.figure: Kulim expansion investment EUR 1.5-2.0 billion; Chongqing CAPEX double-digit million euro range
